segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר עוּלָּא: וְהוּא שֶׁנִּיכָּר לִשְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי אָדָם.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» With regard to an oath taken in vain that denies that which is known to people, «Ulla says:» It is considered known to people when «it is» a fact «that is known to three people.»

moves.cueHe: אמר עולא והוא שניכר לשלשה בני אדם
moves.summary: Ulla qualifies the mishna's first case
moves.about: the mishna's 'known to people' applies only when known to three people

edges.about: the mishna's 'known to people' applies only when known to three people

positions.claim: a vain oath denying the known requires the fact to be known to three people
